scope: Selected formal state and royal-house awards of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, from the nineteenth century to the present; this is a partial pictured batch.
source_boundary: World Medals Index (medals.org.uk) Netherlands Text List: all 34 linked award object pages opened. 33 complete-front image candidates were identified; 21 rows across 12 award families were selected, downloaded from the original site and decoded. This is not a claim that the directory or national award record is globally exhaustive.
